description: This file defines constants, data structures, and methods for managing RF and IR remote control mappings, including RF descriptors, network and controller management, and setting key action mappings with direct database updates.

classes.name: RemoteActionMappingHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to manage RF4CE network IDs, remote controllers, and key mappings.

methods.name: getRf4ceNetworkID
methods.description: Retrieves the RF4CE network ID by querying the IARM bus.

methods.name: getRf4ceBindRemotes
methods.description: Gets the list of bound RF4CE remotes, ordered by last use.

methods.name: getLastUsedDeviceID
methods.description: Returns the device ID of the most recently used remote, along with its type and IR code support info.

methods.name: getControllerByID
methods.description: Retrieves controller info for a given device ID.

methods.name: setKeyActionMap
methods.description: Sets the IR/RF key mapping for a specific device, updating the IR-RF database directly.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCode
methods.description: Sets 5-digit TV and AVR codes in the IR database for a device, updating status flags accordingly.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCodeFlags
methods.description: Sets flags related to 5-digit code modes, such as download or clear operations, in the IR database.

methods.name: getControllerLoadStatus
methods.description: Retrieves load status bytes for TV and AVR from the controller's IR database.

methods.name: cancelCodeDownload
methods.description: Cancels pending IR code downloads by clearing relevant database entries and resetting flags.

methods.name: lookupRFKey
methods.description: Maps internal key identifiers to RF key codes.

methods.name: lookupKeyname
methods.description: Maps RF key codes back to internal key identifiers.
